name: goggles
description: Robot Goggles (issue #79): robots outlined through a wall, red (empty) to green (full) by charge, only while the goggles are on the head. Three robots with 0, half and full batteries stand behind a three-thick stone wall, one more stands in the open to the side and is shot close up, to check its body is not washed out. The outline is vanilla's glowing pass, so what to check per node is that it shows at all (the render-state nodes draw the cube through a model part, 1.21.1 through the outline-aware buffer source) and that its colour tracks the charge.

steps.label: stand in the rig's chunks first (a fresh world has them unloaded)
clear leftovers, floor, wall
run: item replace entity @p armor.head with minecraft:air

steps.label: robots: empty, half and full behind the wall, one in the open

steps.name: no-goggles
steps.look: bare head: the stone wall fills the view and the three robots behind it are NOT visible

steps.label: put the goggles on the head
run: item replace entity @p armor.head with buildcraftunofficial:goggles

steps.name: goggles
steps.look: goggles on: the three robots behind the wall are outlined and visible THROUGH it. Left of the three is green (full), the middle olive/dim yellow-green (half), the right red (empty)

steps.name: goggles-angle
steps.look: from an angle the outlines still follow the cubes; colours unchanged

steps.name: open-robot-goggles
steps.look: goggles on, looking at the robot in the open: its body is the normal robot (grey casing, red LED decal on its side) with a coloured outline around it, mostly green; it must NOT be washed out to white

steps.label: take the goggles off
run: item replace entity @p armor.head with minecraft:air

steps.name: open-robot-bare
steps.look: bare head, same view: the same robot with no outline and the same body as in the goggles shot

steps.label: right-click equips: goggles in the hand, head bare (survival: creative copies the stack instead of swapping it)
run: item replace entity @p armor.head with minecraft:air
item replace entity @p weapon.mainhand with buildcraftunofficial:goggles

steps.label: expect pass: the goggles are now on the head
run: execute if items entity @p armor.head buildcraftunofficial:goggles

steps.label: expect pass: the hand is empty again (swapped, not copied)
run: execute unless items entity @p weapon.mainhand buildcraftunofficial:goggles
item replace entity @p armor.head with minecraft:air
